_help: Each style = an art model + the words that describe the look. 'models' is tried in order (first one that loads wins). A model can be a Hugging Face repo id OR the path to a .safetensors checkpoint you downloaded (any Stable Diffusion 1.5 checkpoint works). Add your own styles by copying a block.

Anime.prompt: anime screencap, anime style, cel shading, flat colors, clean lineart, vibrant colors, masterpiece, best quality

Anime Film (painterly).prompt: ghibli style, hand painted anime film, soft painted background, clean lineart, warm colors

Comic Book.prompt: charliebo artstyle, comic book illustration, bold black ink outlines, flat saturated colors, halftone shading, dynamic

Graphic Novel.prompt: marioalberti artstyle, graphic novel illustration, heavy inks, dramatic shadows, detailed linework

Pop Comic Animation.prompt: spiderverse style, stylized comic animation, halftone dots, bold colors, ink lines

3D Cartoon.prompt: modern disney style, 3d animated movie, cute stylized characters, smooth shading, big expressive eyes

Painted Animation.prompt: arcane style, painterly animation, textured brush strokes, dramatic lighting

Ink Punk.prompt: nvinkpunk, ink illustration, splashes of color, bold graphic shapes

Cartoon Illustration.prompt: cartoon illustration, flat vector art, bold outlines, simple shapes, bright colors

Watercolor.prompt: watercolor painting, soft washes of color, paper texture, loose brushwork, illustration

Pixel Art.prompt: pixel art, 16-bit retro video game, limited color palette, crisp pixels
